verdict.rationale: Bento documents plain-English signals (detectors) that are trained on your traces, fire in real time on production traffic, and backfill history. It also says releases are scored on live traffic, not only offline or in CI, which covers the core of continuous online evaluation. Missing for 10: detailed docs on evaluator configuration (scoring metrics, sampling rates, custom or LLM-judge evaluators), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing and docs claims.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets

citations.quote: Bento trains a detector on your own traces, fires it in real time, and backfills your history.
Every release scored against your production history — offline, in CI, and on live traffic.
The nudge ships in shadow mode, is scored against the outcome it was meant to fix
